proven_mechanisms.name: save receipt can replace requested deliverable
proven_mechanisms.cause: Final completeness validation calls missingAnswerBody with receiptOnly=false. The receipt-only handling in the earlier-body recovery branch does not itself require a task answer. A successful save receipt with a closing question can therefore return final even when the request asks for finished content.

observed_bounds.causally_resolved_by_fix: NOT_RUN; these are exposure counts, not uplift

proven_mechanisms.acceptance: A completed fact write must not replace a separately requested answer or draft. Return the requested content from eligible facts or ask a concrete missing-fact question. A repair must be bounded, read-only and must not repeat a successful write. Preserve normal receipts for fact-only statements.

proven_mechanisms.name: search fallback depends on provider filtering before local filtering
proven_mechanisms.cause: The tool shortens a query only when deps.postings(query) returns an empty pool. The evaluation fixture ignores query and returns a nonempty entire pool; local all-word matching can then return zero without reaching the fallback. A query-filtering provider reaches the fallback.

proven_mechanisms.acceptance: The evaluation provider must honor the production query contract, or the tool must define and test post-filter empty behavior. Preserve saved constraints, report any relaxation, and use full posting retrieval when the requested answer requires requirements absent from search hits.

proven_mechanisms.name: existing tracker role input is silently ignored
proven_mechanisms.cause: The wrapper accepts a role but the existing-row path calls company-only manualUpdate, which changes only stage. The supplied role is used only when adding a new row. Company lookup also selects the first matching company, without distinguishing two roles.

proven_mechanisms.acceptance: Resolve an update by stable application identity, asking when ambiguous. Apply the requested supported fields and build the receipt from the returned stored row. A no-op must not claim the changed value.

proven_mechanisms.name: qualitative outcome invention is outside token fact classification
proven_mechanisms.cause: The guard classifies enumerated skills, titles, degrees, number forms, result vocabulary and place/month tokens. An unsupported qualitative outcome can contain none of these and receive an empty untracedFacts result.
